Get Started in 3 Steps

Set up your AI assistant in just a few minutes

1

Get Your API Key

Create a Google Cloud project and generate your Gemini API key

2

Install Extension

Download Crius07 extension for Chrome - Load as unpacked extension in Developer mode

1. Enable Developer mode in Chrome Extensions
2. Click "Load unpacked" and select the Crius07 folder

3

Start Chatting

Enter your API key in the extension and start having conversations with any webpage

You're all set! Start using Crius07 on any website.
